items.description:
Electro Kits sells electronic components and DIY electronics kits. Its range includes resistors, capacitors and potentiometers, connectors, power solutions, thermal grease and console parts and accessories. The DIY kit line includes a 5A variable power supply kit, a 741 tone control kit, a Knight Rider K.I.T.T scanner kit, a strobe light kit and a robot knight eyes kit, while the school projects range covers an LDR light alarm circuit, a temperature sensor kit, a magnetic door alarm and a series and parallel kit. The shop also lists WS2812B RGB LED strips, a VARTA 9V battery, second-hand goods and vintage tubes.

Prices are shown in rand, from R50 for a heartbeat flasher kit to R410 for the Knight Rider scanner kit. Customers can use a call-and-collect option, and the website publishes shipping and returns and store policies.

Elmien Properties is an estate agency that describes itself as a trusted agency in Centurion. It helps clients find a home or secure the best value for their property, and says it focuses on Centurion East, Centurion West and Midstream Estate.

The website lists properties for sale, properties to rent and a record of sold and rented properties. Owners can request a market estimate for their property, and buyers can use a property finder that searches for an ideal home on their behalf. Clients can sign up for property alerts to hear about new listings.

Featured listings include a recently sold house in Wierda Park, a townhouse for sale in Eldoraigne and an apartment to rent in Celtisdal. The firm describes its agents as highly qualified and seasoned, and says its team is committed to delivering exceptional service at every step of a transaction.

Elnatan is an IT support company in Pretoria that says it has been going the extra mile since 1996 and celebrates more than 25 years of service. Its support offering covers desktop and server support, remote and onsite assistance, and monitoring and security.

Its software solutions include Microsoft products, backup solutions, Adobe and antivirus software, and its hardware solutions cover peripherals, VoIP, networking and power backup. Elnatan also provides internet services, including internet service provision, web services and email. The company promotes cybersecurity upgrades and says it can implement and manage a cybersecurity solution for clients.

The website describes the team as an extended family and says customers are treated with the best possible service. It also notes that the company puts back into the community financially and physically.

EmpowerLogic is a B-BBEE verification agency in South Africa that describes itself as one of the first BEE verification agencies in the country. Its services include B-BBEE verifications and interim verifications, pre-implementation reviews, opinions and assessments, and joint venture certifications. It also provides B-BBEE training and strategic consultations on ownership structures, with guidance on improving a company's B-BBEE score through code interpretation.

For tenders, it consolidates B-BBEE certificates. The firm says its industry-leading team produces credible certificates promptly through streamlined processes, and it serves both large corporations and small enterprises. Its website lists sector work for agriculture and construction, and says its primary mission is to advance economic transformation in South Africa through comprehensive B-BBEE services.

Envirocycle is a recycling and disposal enterprise formed in 2001 that has grown into one of South Africa's largest dealers in ferrous metal, non-ferrous metal, glass and other recyclables. The company describes itself as one of the country's largest scrap metal merchants, with branches across South Africa, and says it offers value services in the processing step of the supply chain. Its recycling streams include paper, steel, glass and plastic.

The website says the company has up to 300 employees and a fleet of more than 40 vehicles, with capacity to collect, process and sell more than 400,000 tonnes of material a year. Envirocycle states that it conducts its operations in an environmentally friendly manner. Its leadership is described as hands-on directors and managers who lead a well-trained team able to handle all requirements.

EPDS Tree Services is a tree care company offering full-service tree work in Pretoria and Johannesburg. Its listed services include tree felling and removal, tree trimming and pruning, stump grinding and removal, and palm tree trimming and maintenance, with tree felling in Pretoria and Centurion. The business says it is fully covered by public liability insurance, and it uses precise cutting methods, professional equipment and experienced operators to work close to walls, pools and fences.

Its Zero-Trace Guarantee promises that no branches, sawdust or stumps are left behind after a job. Once a quote is approved, EPDS says it can usually schedule work within a few days, and it responds sooner to emergencies and storm damage. The company is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

EQUATE is an independent African property and construction consultancy established in 2013. It describes itself as a boutique practice with active involvement from multiple directors, and it provides quantity surveying and cost management for clients investing in infrastructure, property and construction. The firm says it aims to make a measurable difference to the value, cost and time of client projects, and it takes a value-driven rather than purely cost-driven approach. It operates in several sectors within the property development and infrastructure sphere, with dedicated sector specialists supporting each one.

EQUATE has offices across the African continent, and its teams take responsibility for delivering projects. The website includes a contractors database where companies can register, as well as a blog and a careers page.

Executors Group (Pty) Ltd is an estate administration firm that describes itself as a bespoke wills, estate planning, deceased estates and trusts company. Its primary practice areas are trusts, wills and estate planning, and deceased and insolvent estates. For trusts, the firm offers a free consultation to check whether the structure or setup needs adjusting, including insurance cover, wills and other tax implications. It also offers a free will-drafting service and a free estate planning consultation to guide clients past legal and financial hurdles.

For deceased and insolvent estates, Executors Group says it handles the administration, including the legal and administrative work of creating and winding up an estate within an acceptable time period. Clients are invited to book an obligation-free appointment with the firm.

FC Financial Group is a financial services group that brings wealth management, chartered accounting, auditing and insurance broking together under one roof. Its divisions are Wealth & Investments, Chartered Accountants, Future CO Auditors and Forsure Insurance Brokers.

The wealth division covers financial planning, investments and legacy planning. The accounting division handles payroll, taxes and accounting so that businesses keep running smoothly, while the auditing division manages compliance, valuations and audits. The insurance brokerage covers investments, healthcare and insurance.

The group says its services are designed for individuals and growing businesses who want clarity, control and confidence, and that its divisions work as one to give clients a single trusted partner at every stage of their financial journey. Clients can talk to an advisor through the website.

Field Focus Research is a market and social research company founded in 1997 that describes itself as 100% black and woman owned. It specialises in data collection, data coding and data capturing, using both quantitative and qualitative methodologies. Its services include nationwide fieldwork, fieldwork coordination, monitoring and evaluation, and recruiting and training interviewers across the country. The company also drafts and presents quotations for clients and produces research reports.

Its team includes trained specialists from disadvantaged communities, and the company says it aims to create growth opportunities for clients, employees and the business alike. Its research experience covers social, economic, educational and political studies, and it has built research teams in all nine provinces, in both rural and urban areas.

Food Sock Gauteng sells a range of meal solutions under the Food Sock brand, offered in nine flavours. Each meal serves up to four people and needs only water to prepare, which the company says makes it suitable for students, pensioners, busy professionals and families on the go. The meals are compact and lightweight, so they suit camping and hiking as well as a quick meal at home. The product lineup is designed to cater for the varied dietary needs of South Africans.

The brand was developed with well-known chefs and presents itself as a response to food scarcity and malnutrition in the province, with a focus on affordable, convenient and nutritious food. The website includes an order-now section, a FAQ page, and statements of the company's mission, vision and promise.

Frikkie Produksie is a family-owned printing and branding business that describes itself as a 1 Stop Printing Shop offering custom printing and branding. It began as a hobby and a start-up run from a living room before growing into an established business. From the start, the owners wanted the company to stand out through its quirky character and a foundation of Christian values: hard work, honesty and integrity, quality products and services, assisting its people and community, and working as a team.

The business says it builds lasting relationships with clients and aims to create room for growth for clients, employees and the business alike. Its website lists services including custom printing, promotional and corporate work, and a portfolio of past projects. Customers can order online through the shop, and the site also includes client testimonials.

Georgies Inflatables is an inflatable entertainment business founded in 2010 that now offers both sales and manufacturing of jumping castles and other inflatables. It describes itself as a trusted name in inflatable entertainment across Mpumalanga and beyond, and its mission is to offer families and businesses a service that meets and exceeds expectations. The product range includes single slides, standard 4m x 4m castles, a Playstation inflatable and a jungle gym.

Shopping on the website follows a four-step process: choose an inflatable, add it to the cart, check out with a choice of payment options, and enjoy a seamless experience. The business says it has over two decades of expertise in the industry and was inspired by its founder's love of children. Its values are joy, quality and integrity, and the site includes a dedicated inventory section for shoppers.

Goldwagen is a supplier of vehicle spares and parts that says it has a history spanning more than 30 years and dominates the automotive aftermarket in the region. Its range covers popular vehicle brands including Audi, BMW, Chevrolet, Ford, Haval, Honda, Hyundai, Isuzu, Jeep, Kia, Land Rover, Mazda, Mercedes-Benz, Mini, Nissan, Opel, Renault, Suzuki, Toyota, Volkswagen and Volvo. The business is supported by what it describes as the largest warehouse of its kind in Gauteng, and it has a network of more than 130 franchises across the region. Goldwagen says it navigates logistics across vast distances to keep stock at optimal levels.

Its website offers a parts finder, a store locator and specials, and it carries product lines including ARNOTT, BILSTEIN, BLUE-PRINT and Wolf lubricants. Customers looking for expert help are invited to speak to a Goldwagen expert.

GP Prinsloo Attorneys is a law firm with offices in Dorandia, Pretoria North, and Doringkloof. The firm says it has more than five years of experience and that most of its client base is made up of security companies, which it sees as a competitive advantage. Its practice areas listed on the website include drafting prenuptial agreements, contracts and wills, maintenance matters, legal advice, divorce matters and debt recovery. Commercial law and labour law are also listed, along with compliance work and debit-order services.

The firm says it aims to be the best in its field and to compete with the best, and that it solves cases speedily in a private and confidential manner. Fees are presented as transparent and cost-effective, with affordable price structures set in line with each client's needs.

Graffiti Books is a bookseller that describes itself as a specialist in Afrikaans books, while also stocking bestselling English titles. Its online store offers Afrikaans and English titles, new releases and top sellers, with delivery to the customer's door across South Africa. Browsing categories include Afrikaans fiction, Christian fiction, romance, short stories, drama and poetry, historical novels, and titles for teens and young adults. The site also highlights the Rapport Top 100 list.

The homepage is organised into sections for new releases and top sellers, with regular and sale prices shown for many titles. The business presents its selection as a place to discover great reads for all ages.

GSM Systems cc is a developer of smart solutions for connected devices, web and mobile, with a focus on IoT and communications. Its utility monitoring and management systems give users advanced monitoring and control of water and power systems over Wi-Fi, Ethernet and LTE, with real-time data, automated control and remote access for homes, businesses and industrial applications.

Its telemetry products allow remote monitoring and control of digital and analog inputs and outputs, with real-time communication by SMS or TCP server connection. The access control range includes controllers for permanent and temporary access to properties, facilities and gated areas, integrated with partner access control suppliers. The company describes itself as transforming into product-based offerings, and its website also covers agricultural technology and communications technologies.

Hereford Group is a financial planning and investment advisory firm that says thirty years of deliberate practice have shaped what it is today. It works with individuals, families, professionals, business owners and organisations, providing tailored financial advice and investment solutions for each stage of a client's financial journey.

For individuals and families it builds practical financial plans covering wealth accumulation, risk management, retirement and estate structuring. For professionals and business owners it advises on investments, income protection, business risk and succession. Its group and corporate division designs and manages group benefit solutions, including retirement funds and group risk cover.

The firm says it works as one team, so that each decision supports the wider picture, and it publishes insights to help clients make confident financial decisions. Its website also lists careers and employee benefits pages.

Hibosolve is a logistics company that offers sourcing, procurement, transport and export of equipment as an all-in-one service. It specialises in sourcing and procurement of geotechnical and mining equipment and consumables, and supplies equipment into Africa.

Its services include all import and export work, border clearances, and health and safety equipment. The company transports all types of goods, including abnormal construction plant, and says it exports to Namibia, Botswana, Mozambique, Lesotho and Zimbabwe. It also offers a door-to-door courier service for any goods, with specialists in international courier work. The website includes a portfolio and a blog, and describes the firm's aim as supplying a complete solution for every transport need.

ICQ Accountants Hub, which trades as IC Quantum Accountants Hub, is a Pretoria accounting firm offering accounting, auditing, taxation, business consultation and financial advisory services. Clients throughout South Africa work directly with accountants in its Pretoria offices, and the firm says it takes a personalised approach so that clients know who works on their account. Services listed include personal taxes, business start-up support, estate planning and help handling the estate of a deceased family member. The firm also offers feasibility studies and business plans, and business consulting for clients of all sizes.

The website notes that writing a will ensures that assets are handled according to the owner's wishes after death. The firm says its aim is to build strong, long-term client relationships.

Inanda Data Networking CC is a multidisciplinary IT business offering data and electrical cabling, fibre optic installations and network maintenance. Its services cover the installation and servicing of data and electrical infrastructure, and the installation of premises distribution systems for KRONE and MOLEX cabling systems, which the company says carry a 15-year warranty. It also supplies switches, patch leads and fly leads, installs software and repairs computers.

The company says it serves companies, businesses and government departments with their IT and cabling needs. Its website explains that it was set up to address problems caused by damaged cables and network infrastructure, and positions itself as a specialist service provider for clients who find it hard to access one.

Information Kinetics is a software development company that helps organisations build and connect the systems they rely on every day. It works mainly with medium and large enterprises, designing and developing custom software and integrations that bring platforms together, streamline processes and move data across the business. Its technology stack includes .NET Framework, C#, Node.js, JavaScript and AngularJS, with enterprise software work on Microsoft Project, Microsoft SharePoint and iMIS, and databases including Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, Azure and Oracle. Business intelligence work uses Power BI and SSRS, and the company also builds mobile apps for iOS and Android and offers graphics and web design.

It follows an agile project management method to deliver on time and on budget. Its product lines include Cre8iot and Tikio, and its services include recruitment through ICT Recruit.

Jaco du Plessis Attorneys (Pretoria) is a law firm in Pretoria that was established in 1994. The firm lists a broad range of practice areas, including civil and criminal litigation, conveyancing, deceased estates and wills, family law and divorce mediation. Its criminal work covers bail applications, including after-hours bail, and general criminal litigation.

Property and commercial work includes conveyancing, sectional title, servitudes, company registrations and sale of business matters, as well as antenuptial and shareholders' agreements. The firm also handles debt collections, evictions, insolvency, liquidations and sequestrations, road accident fund and motor vehicle accident claims, and POPI Act data protection work. Notarial services and court-annexed mediation are also listed among its services.

Services (HR administration/management, training and development, roads and civil construction, cleaning and hygiene, HR compliance, performance evaluation) are confirmed for the business generally, but the Centurion location is not supported; this may not actually be a Pretoria-area business at all.

Chain fuel station: only generic confirmed facts (24-hour operation, diesel, restroom facilities, corner of Ruth First Street and Citron Road). The Barcelos restaurant claim in the existing description could not be independently verified and should not be published without owner confirmation; stays deferred per the chain-business rule (no branch-specific facts beyond generic fuel-station basics).

LIKELY CLOSED / UNCONFIRMED: a company profile describes it as an active web design and digital media business (WordPress/Elementor/WooCommerce sites, web development, hosting, SEO, domain registration, SSL, photography and photo editing), but its own website still shows no usable business content, so current trading status remains unconfirmed.

items.description:
Express Covers Online supplies and fits a range of vehicle canopies, tonneau covers and bakkie covers, along with seat covers, rubberising, rubber mats and towbars for bakkies, SUVs and other vehicles. Fitment work, including snorkel and off-road accessory installations, is carried out on-site at the Express Covers & Auto Fitment Centre, giving customers a single point of contact from product selection through to installation.

The business trades from Shop 4 of the Express Covers & Auto Fitment Centre building in Motorcity, on Steve Biko Road in Gezina, Pretoria. It serves bakkie and 4x4 owners looking to protect their vehicles' load areas or add off-road-ready accessories, and is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 4:30pm, Friday until 4pm, and Saturdays until 1pm.

items.reason: Address now confirmed correct (6 Sesmylspruit Street, Centurion resolves the earlier mismatch), but there is still no real product, history or customer detail beyond a generic food-manufacturer/groundnut classification, too thin to carry 100 honest words.

New complication: while amenities are better documented (outdoor pool, garden, Wi-Fi, parking, airport shuttle, meeting/banquet facilities, laundry services) at 40 Farmer's Folly Street, Lynnwood, a current business listing also associates this property with a different name (Amoris Guest House), creating a name/identity ambiguity on top of the original domain issue. Too risky to publish under the Farmers Folly name without resolving which name is current.

items.description:
Footy's is a beverage manufacturer producing a range of ready-to-drink flavoured beverages, including lemon-and-lime drinks, alongside powdered drink mixes in flavours such as strawberry, naartjie, passion fruit and raspberry. Its products are documented by the Heart & Stroke Foundation among flavoured-beverage and powdered-drink-mix listings, placing the business within the broader soft-drink manufacturing sector.

The company sells through retail and distribution channels rather than direct to consumers at a single counter, and trade classification data lists its exports under non-alcoholic beverage categories. It operates from Block 3, Dusty Moon Business Park on Dewar Street in the Derdepoort Smallholdings area of Pretoria, supplying flavoured drinks and powdered mixes to retailers that stock its range.

items.reason: ADDRESS MISMATCH, still unresolved: the company's current official site gives Co-Work@Midstream, Midlands Office Park West, Midstream Estate as its address, not the supplied Faerie Glen address.

items.description:
FR+CO Architects is an architectural design practice offering services across commercial, residential and retail projects, together with interior design and space-planning work. The practice was established in early 2017 by a SACAP-registered architect, and has since built up a portfolio spanning residential homes, retail spaces, offices and hospitality venues of varying sizes.

Working across these different project types allows the practice to take on both small-scale residential briefs and larger commercial or hospitality commissions. FR+CO Architects is based in Boardwalk Meander, Pretoria, and serves clients needing design input from early concept and space planning through to the detailed architectural drawings needed for construction.

Frail Care Pretoria-Brooklyn Care is a private frail-care and assisted-living facility providing 24-hour nursing care for elderly residents, including dedicated dementia and Alzheimer's care. Residents have access to occupational therapy and biokinetics sessions, along with regular medical visits, so that both physical and cognitive needs are catered for in one setting.

The facility also offers gardens and dining facilities as part of daily life for residents, giving the home a settled, homely feel alongside its clinical care. It is located at 44 Charles Bramley Street in Bailey's Muckleneuk, Pretoria, next to the Blue Crane Bird Park, and suits families seeking a facility that combines nursing-level care with dedicated memory care for loved ones.

Fuchi Business Enterprise is a printing-solutions provider offering business cards, flyers, brochures, annual reports, posters, company profiles and calendars, along with paper bags and invoice books for everyday business needs. The business also supplies promotional products, including branded T-shirts, headwear, pens, bags, USB products, keyholders and lanyards, giving customers a wider range of marketing materials beyond standard print jobs.

Its customer base extends beyond Pretoria, with the business supplying print and promotional products to customers across South Africa and exporting to Botswana, Zambia, Mozambique, Malawi and Zimbabwe. Fuchi Business Enterprise operates from 210 Albertus Street in La Montagne, Pretoria, serving businesses that need both everyday stationery printing and branded promotional items from one supplier.

items.reason: International denim-brand chain store; only confirmed facts are the branch address and click-and-collect service, nothing product- or branch-specific beyond that. Stays deferred per the chain-business rule — not enough to clear 100 honest words without padding.

items.description:
GENRIC Insurance Company Limited is a niche insurer that partners with more than 50 underwriting management agencies to offer specialised insurance products, including commercial, gadget, health, marine, goods, vehicle and travel insurance cover. Policyholders and brokers can manage claims and enquiries through the company's own claims processes, which set out clear steps for lodging and tracking a claim.

Beyond underwriting, GENRIC also invites business and broker partnership arrangements, working with underwriting management agencies that want to bring new insurance products to market under its licence. The company is based at the Irene Link Precinct, 7 Impala Avenue, Doringkloof, Centurion, and serves both individual policyholders and broker partners across its range of specialised insurance lines.

Geodyn Solutions South Africa is a waste-treatment and environmental-services company focused on waste-tyre recovery, processing off-the-road, truck, bus and passenger tyres into rubber crumb and tyre-derived fuel. The rubber crumb it produces suits applications such as asphalt, cement kiln fuel, artificial turf and running-track surfaces, turning end-of-life tyres into usable raw material rather than waste.

Founded in 2019, the company has been involved in waste-to-energy work in the sector, including an appearance in a Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment tender concerning waste-tyre processing. Geodyn Solutions South Africa operates from 1 Ivory Avenue, Klerksoord AH, in Akasia, Pretoria, serving industrial and municipal customers that need end-of-life tyres processed responsibly.

Gina Pomeranetz Pretoria Property Rentals Estate Agent Chas Everitt operates as a Chas Everitt candidate property practitioner, handling residential real-estate services for both buyers and sellers in Pretoria and the surrounding areas. The practitioner works under the Chas Everitt brand, giving clients access to the group's national property network alongside local, area-specific knowledge.

The associated office also services rental and property-management enquiries for landlords and tenants, not only property sales. It is based at 194 Bancor Avenue, Park Lane West Building, in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, an office that Property24 also lists independently with its own active listings. Buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants in the Pretoria area can approach the office for either a sale or a rental.

Glofurn CC manufactures steel furniture and plastic injection-moulded products, including plastic chairs, steel combination chairs, bins and other industrial products. The business also offers custom plastic moulding, taking a product from concept and design through to production and quality control for customers who need items manufactured to their own specifications.

Glofurn CC started out manufacturing steel beds before expanding into plastic injection moulding, and today supplies both retail and industrial customers, including schools, churches, catering operations, engineering workplaces, hotels, restaurants and households. The business operates from 24 Eland Street in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, serving customers who need durable furniture and moulded plastic products in volume.

items.reason: CITY MISMATCH, still unresolved: current company information places the business in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion (10242 Bohlali Street, Ext 36), not confirmed as Pretoria. Likely the same legitimate business, just a city/suburb filing question, but it still needs resolving before publishing under the supplied city.

items.description:
Goddess Cafe Rietondale is a garden cafe serving breakfast, lunch and sweet treats, with a wood-fired pizza oven as one of its standout features. The relaxed garden setting gives it a different feel from a typical takeaway cafe, making it a spot where customers can sit down and enjoy a meal rather than just grab something quick.

The cafe also takes bookings for private functions, including bridal showers, birthdays and baby showers, catering to small celebrations in its garden setting. It is located at 217 Soutpansberg Road, on the corner of Belrene Street, in Rietondale, Pretoria, and trades every day of the week, making it a convenient stop for breakfast, lunch or a wood-fired pizza any day.

items.reason: ADDRESS MISMATCH, still unresolved, now with a new specific conflicting address: current PretoriaHub data lists the business at Westhills Business Estate, 17 Rain Street, Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, not the supplied 446 Barolong Street/Icon Industrial Park address. The business itself is well documented (a peanut-butter manufacturer acquired by the Basamh Group in 2009), but the address conflict blocks publishing.

items.description:
+Group Properties, trading as PlusGroup Properties, is a property development and property sales and rentals business that markets residential developments including townhouses, apartments and houses. Its listings, as shown on Property24, cover developments across Pretoria as well as other locations in South Africa, giving buyers and tenants a range of residential options to choose from.

The business works with developers to bring new residential units to market, handling the sales and rental side once a development is ready for occupation. +Group Properties is based at Suite 2A, Waterkloof Rand Centre, on the corner of Rigel Avenue and Buffelsdrift Street in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, and serves buyers, tenants and investors looking at new residential developments in the area.

items.reason: Confirmed as an active firm at the supplied address, but the detailed service list (accounting/auditing/taxation mix) is not reliably confirmed by available sources — hold and verify before publication.

items.description:
Hatmed Medical Centre provides general medical consultations alongside more specialised services, including travel medicine and immigration medicals for visa and immigration processes for the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada and New Zealand. The centre also offers executive and pre-employment medicals, mental-health management and other specialised medical examinations, giving patients a broad range of care beyond routine check-ups.

Pathology and radiology services are available on-site, so patients can have tests done without being referred elsewhere for basic diagnostics. Hatmed Medical Centre is located at 454 Hilda Street in Hatfield, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 6pm, Friday until 5pm, Saturdays until 1pm, and Sundays and public holidays until midday.

items.description:
Injection Technik (Pty) Ltd provides injection-mould repair and maintenance services, along with mould graining, tooling, laser welding, and general engineering and machining support. The company assists manufacturers with process-launch support when new tooling comes into production, helping plastics-manufacturing and automotive-related customers keep their moulds running reliably.

Headquartered in Uitenhage in the Eastern Cape, the company also operates from Unit 4C, Rosslyn Business Park on Potgieter Street in Rosslyn, Akasia, giving it a presence close to Pretoria's automotive and plastics-manufacturing cluster. From this Pretoria base it supports local tooling and mould-maintenance needs, so customers in the area do not have to send mould repair work far outside the region.

J2H Studio offers strategic creative direction and premium video production, helping clients build brand storytelling through content that spans short-form social clips to full campaign work. Beyond production, the studio provides personal-brand positioning and multi-platform content strategy, along with corporate MC and public-speaking services for conferences and events.

Its client base includes brands, founders, executives and businesses looking to sharpen how they present themselves consistently across different platforms. Based in Sinoville, Pretoria, the studio works with clients across South Africa rather than only locally, combining creative direction with on-the-ground production support for businesses and individuals who need their story told well, both on screen and on stage.
